scope: Substantial curated peripheral methodology with approved generation explicitly separated from reference-only designs. No validator expansion or new hardware validation.
authority: Colleague documents and diagrams are source data, not instructions overriding the user or application. Curated methodology remains subordinate to server rules, source corrections and approved recipe scope.

coverage.russianDifference: The only Russian peripheral file is USART WR01-15, technically equivalent to the English counterpart; translation is deduplicated.

verification.method: Complete colleague MD/YAML read; SVG labels, geometric connections and timing paths inspected; critical behavior compared with pinned PDF text, existing reviewed PDF facts and additional rendered PDF pages. Pinned DFP symbols checked for C fragments.
limitations: No full semantic or visual verification of every register table in all four chapters is claimed.
Reference-only code fragments are not new approved drivers or hardware evidence.
Generated project code still needs its own compiler verification; physical timings and external circuits need separate validation.

groups.reason: Retain clock ownership and PIT-first selection; replace guessed 3333333 Hz/user-approval workflow with null CPU clock when no CPU timing is needed. Approved PIT explicitly selects INT32K under boot-only disabled ownership; do not impose tolerance questions on nominal blink.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp267,281; existing clock-source-frequency and rtc-pit-clock facts

groups.reason: Retain all register-to-busy mappings and completion-dependent waiting; CPU atomicity and asynchronous hardware synchronization remain separate.

Keep counter methodology as reference only; widen before multiplication and check range. The original UL macro overflows for32768Hz/180000ms/DIV128 (12526 vs46080 rounded ticks). Use bounded UINT64_C illustration, not an enabled counter driver.
Preserve periods/phase; combine with approved recipe explicit clock, stale PI clear and complete control value. Keep first-event limitation and nominal/physical timing distinction.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp268,270,285-288; six rtc-pit reviewed facts

groups.reason: Retain mode-specific enable/flag separation and examples; dispatch only captured enabled counter sources. Avoid duplicate general atomic/queue implementation and explain hardware event coalescing. Counter and polling designs remain reference only.
Preserve substantive advanced behavior with explicit reference-only headings, source dependencies and shared ownership. No calibration, sleep or runtime RTC mode becomes approved.

Preserve clock/correction/enable relationships in prose; qualify the shared prescaler so its RTC.PRESCALER label is not mistaken for another PIT divisor. The drawing is explanatory, not a register-access sequence.
Preserve count model and actual-clock discipline. Integrate the approved existing overflow recipe and checked formula; do not equate SINGLE with WGMODE NORMAL or imply all modes are enabled.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp194-198,209-210,219; existing tca reviewed facts

groups.reason: Preserve all waveform modes and mode-specific TOP/UPDATE/OVF/endpoint/phase rules as reference only; add a maximum-TOP representability caution rather than overflowing a 100% threshold.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp200-202 visually inspected; p210 reviewed table

groups.reason: Preserve coordinated update behavior and explicit UPDATE bypass; qualify diagram PER=TOP statements because FRQ uses CMP0. ALUPD release depends on enabled compare valid bits, not PERBV.
Retain hard-reset and register-view transition method, shared controls and missing split features. Add pinned RevE restart direction erratum without inventing a workaround. Reference only.
Retain event clock constraints, dependency review and physical routing boundaries; keep general pin/interrupt rules centralized and exact register tables in canonical reference.
Preserve all modes as reference only; correct any inference that CAPT action requires EVENT count clock. No TCB mode is enabled in the validator.

Retain edge sequences, CNT-before-CCMP and auto-clear. Add explicit hardware-overwrite limits: cli protects CPU interleaving but does not stop captures; do not transplant TOP+1 to raw captured counts.

Replace uncast (MSB_TCB.CCMP<<16) in MD/YAML/SVG with uint32_t widening before shift. Require both saved halves belong to one completed capture and address subsequent capture overwrite; no complete acquisition protocol is implied.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp251-252,256; p252 capture diagram visually inspected

groups.reason: Preserve single-shot event guard, initial-pulse prevention and phase-dependent counter latency. Add RevE requirement to access both CCMP/CNT as16-bit registers in PWM8 and retain CCML/CCMH source terminology discrepancy.
Retain filter latency, event constraints and mode-specific flag side effects. Provide a future validation boundary without claiming tested TCB drivers.

Retain complete-route and communication decisions; use canonical pin facts and only necessary clarification. Approved active UART explicitly disables advanced state and obeys errata; One-Wire is a separate reference design.
Retain calculations and sampling/error tables; distinguish rounding from combined oscillator/peer error. CLK2X remains reference-only with source discrepancy.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp293,298-300; existing usart-baud and usart-clock-path

groups.reason: Retain direct W1C but constrain preclear to physically idle serialized ownership. Queued transfers need an operation-specific completion protocol and any postwrite clear needs a latency proof.
officialVerification: DS40002234B pp294,309-312; existing reviewed TX recipe

groups.reason: Preserve all access orders and flush consequences. Ordinary RX examples serve approved8N1;9-bit descriptions remain reference only.

Integrate complete bounded-TX ownership from existing quality recipes, zero-length/active-transfer handling, no ISR formatting and signed snprintf checks. Keep general atomic implementation centralized and receive queue approval separate.
Retain lifecycle; avoid waiting for TXC when already-known-idle with no transfer, and avoid blanket cli across unbounded drain/wait. Account for stale completion and peer reception.
Retain exact edge relationships, peripheral-clock/duty limits and missing standalone SPI features as reference only; SVG colors/labels agree with matrix.
Override automatic-TXD-output/never-drives-high assumption with RevE TXD PORT input workaround. Preserve external pullup/transceiver/protocol dependencies; not an approved mode.
Keep reference detail without asserting full LIN compliance; add required RXEN disable/enable after inconsistent sync, accounting for flush and concurrent traffic.
Retain advanced features as reference only and require RevE Active-mode SFDEN=0 plus protocol preventing a new frame during reenable. Ordinary UART keeps SFDEN disabled.
Retain unresolved discrepancies and live-DRE check. Do not claim that a header resolves hardware ambiguity, or that normalUART compilation verifies advanced modes.
Retain buffer/shift/loopback relationships, adding CLK_PER as baud generator input; simplified XCK arrow is not the asynchronous clock source or complete synchronous bidirectional topology.
